I need a formula that will automatically assign these index numbers to the apples. I have filled in the first few cells B9:B13 with index numbers as an example to illustrate what I'm looking for. Could someone please help me automate this process for the complete column of Month No. in Excel? I've attached a sample workbook for reference. Please just place the appropriate month value into column B based on the table B4:V6. In addition, if the apple index number for the row is not present in apples accum row, add 1 to the cell.
